I view this song as a discourse/clash between old friends since the tone and perspective changes. It starts with Noah (or the person that has been distant) singing about feeling fake by supporting a struggling friend because it is all done for an image or ego preservation. The chorus to me seems to be from a more recent time since Noah sings from a more mature period of his life and earnestly compliments this friend for pulling themselves together (this alone seems to insinuate that time has passed since the friend was very messy in the beginning). As the chorus ends, perspective switches and the friend makes many harsh statements,  "help me if it helps you sleep...you grew your hair out long now you think you're jesus christ, there aint nobody mistaking your guilt for some great sacrifice.. you aint a hero cause you cry on TV".
